description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1907/38 of 25.03.2015, Meerigama D/S Division  - Cad. Map No. 510214
reasoning: This gazette exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries making specific amendments to land parcel records, including block number changes, expunging particulars, inserting power of attorney details, and correcting land extent measurements. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title amendments, and property record modifications.
